assertions.description: window.Element exists — the interface the aria-actions DOM reflection (ariaActionsElements) is defined on via ARIAMixin.
window.ElementInternals exists — Chromium includes the AriaRelationshipAttributes mixin on both Element and ElementInternals.

The DOM preserves an aria-actions content-attribute string on a neutral test element. This checks author markup only, not role validity, DOM reflection, accessibility-platform mapping, or AT behavior.
assertions.test: (()=>{ const d = document.createElement('div'); d.setAttribute('aria-actions', 'act-a act-b'); return d.getAttribute('aria-actions') === 'act-a act-b'; })()

assertions.description: element.ariaActionsElements is exposed (typeof 'object' — a nullable FrozenArray<Element>) when the AriaActions runtime feature is on; it is the DOM reflection named by the ARIAMixin correspondence, gated RuntimeEnabled=AriaActions.
ariaActionsElements is also an instance member of ElementInternals via the same Chromium mixin when the AriaActions runtime feature is enabled.
The reflection is named ariaActionsElements (ID reference list), NOT ariaActions: element.ariaActions must not exist as a DOM property (this holds whether or not the feature is enabled).
ariaActionsElements is an instance member, never a static on the Element or ElementInternals constructors (holds whether or not the feature is enabled).
assertions.test: (()=>{ const e = typeof Element === 'undefined' || typeof Element.ariaActionsElements === 'undefined'; const i = typeof ElementInternals === 'undefined' || typeof ElementInternals.ariaActionsElements === 'undefined'; return e && i; })()

assertions.description: When the reflection is present, its value is either null or an Array (the FrozenArray<Element> shape) — never a string, number, or fabricated single element.
assertions.test: (()=>{ const v = document.body.ariaActionsElements; if (typeof v === 'undefined') return false; return v === null || Array.isArray(v); })()

assertions.description: When the reflection is present, a host whose aria-actions IDREF list names one connected button resolves to an array containing exactly that button — null, an empty array, or a different element would violate the valid-reference contract.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof document.body.ariaActionsElements === 'undefined') return false; const host = document.createElement('div'); const btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.id = 'conformance-action-1'; document.body.append(host, btn); host.setAttribute('aria-actions', 'conformance-action-1'); const r = host.ariaActionsElements; const ok = Array.isArray(r) && r.length === 1 && r[0] === btn; host.remove(); btn.remove(); return ok; })()
